user.title: Siri Passthrough
user.description: Point this at the Apple TV Siri Voice bridge. Leave the target blank unless you have more than one Apple TV paired.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered on that URL. If the bridge runs as an add-on, check that its control API is exposed -- Home Assistant is a separate container, so it counts as a different machine.

abort.already_configured: That bridge is already set up.

init.title: Routing
init.description: Leave the entity blank to send every utterance to Siri. Set it, and an utterance only goes to Siri while that entity is in one of the listed states -- anything else is handed to the fallback engine and answered by the fallback agent, so one pipeline serves both the television and the house.
